name: Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd., based in Haikou, China, designs, researches, develops, produces and markets photovoltaic cells in China and abroad, making N-type TOPCon solar cells. Founded in 2003, it was previously named Hainan Drinda Automotive Trim Co., Ltd.
